title: ACCOUNT-SPLIT-1: tenant 0 runs only on the ultrastable Cloudflare account; nothing of Ultrastable is left in quniverse
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** now; cutover when a target-account token is bound
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/cf_account.py transfer verify
**Status:** closed

Owner direction 2026-11-14 (doctrine/providers.json). Worker code is on the target byte-identical, crons off (deploy/transfer/inventory-2026-11-14.json); everything still runs in quniverse. Work per deploy/transfer/plan.json: fix cf_account.py copy (multi-module, service-binding order, D1 refresh, KV pagination) with tests; bind target token; fresh data copy, secrets, topology switch, cron cutover; zones and domains; soak and retire; drift probe fails when any ultrastable-* or us-idea-* resource remains in quniverse.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
